#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Fixed four-way solver-lifecycle/saturation comparison; no retries."""
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import sys
import time

REPO=Path('/home/will/wk/exp/ferrum')
ROOT=Path('/tmp/ferrum-method-saturation-dd263e8')
OUT=ROOT/'experiment'
sys.path.insert(0,str(REPO/'tools/performance/smt'))
from run_saturation import check_outcome, sha, trial, write

OUT.mkdir()
spec=json.loads(Path('/tmp/ferrum-method-solver-235b245/experiment/spec.json').read_text())
spec['kind']='method-solver-saturation-factorial-v1'
spec['source_head']=subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],cwd=REPO,text=True).strip()
spec['runtime_commit']='dd263e882e019cc0e91c594607546266372a9100'
spec.pop('runtime_parent',None);spec.pop('runtime_patch_sha256',None)
spec['profiles']={}
for solver in ['retained','separate']:
 for saturation,weights in [('current','[1,0.5,0.4,0,0]'),('older','[1,0.5,0.4,0.2,0.02]')]:
  spec['profiles'][f'{solver}_{saturation}']={'solver':solver,'saturation':saturation,'weights':weights,
   'options':[f'--separateMethodSolver={str(solver=="separate").lower()}']}
profiles=list(spec['profiles'])
mirrored=[*profiles,*reversed(profiles)]
for case in spec['cases']:case['profiles']=profiles
spec['host']['load']=Path('/proc/loadavg').read_text().strip()
spec['limits']=['Fixed two-by-two comparison: solver lifecycle and the full saturation weight vector.',
 'One worker, branches off, caches on, same existing development binaries and Z3.',
 'Passing/failing array captures in all four modes; two nested captures per mode in mirrored order.',
 'Two untraced timing observations per positive case and mode in the same mirrored order.',
 '60s program / 90s outer / 45s offline limits. No retries or expanded sweep.',
 'All owner and worker solver costs count. Shared-host wall times are noisy; phase timings are inclusive.',
 'The full older vector changes inhale and repetition together; this does not isolate individual slots.']
prior_path=Path('/tmp/ferrum-method-solver-235b245/experiment/trials.jsonl')
old_path=Path('/tmp/ferrum-saturation-short-4bef39a/001-mut_element_nested_pass-legacy-ferrum/trial.json')
references={(r['case'],r['profile']+'_current'):r for line in prior_path.read_text().splitlines() for r in [json.loads(line)]}
references[('mut_element_nested_pass','retained_older')]=json.loads(old_path.read_text())
paths=[spec['z3'],spec['proxy'],spec['supervisor'],*spec['commands']['ferrum'],spec['phase_command'],
 *(c['path'] for c in spec['cases']),str(Path(__file__).resolve()),str(prior_path),str(old_path),
 str(REPO/'crates/ferrum-silicon/src/config.rs'),str(REPO/'src/lib.rs'),
 str(REPO/'tools/performance/smt/run_saturation.py'),str(REPO/'tools/performance/smt/analyze_trace.py')]
spec['artifact_sha256']={p:sha(p) for p in paths}
schedule=[]
for case in ['mut_element_array_wrong','mut_element_array_pass','mut_element_nested_pass']:
 for profile in mirrored if case=='mut_element_nested_pass' else profiles:
  schedule.append({'index':len(schedule),'case':case,'profile':profile,'backend':'ferrum',
   'repetition':sum(r['case']==case and r['profile']==profile for r in schedule),
   'control':case!='mut_element_nested_pass'})
phase_schedule=[{'index':i,'case':case,'profile':profile} for i,(case,profile) in enumerate(
 (case,profile) for case in ['mut_element_nested_pass','mut_element_array_pass'] for profile in mirrored)]
write(OUT/'spec.json',spec);write(OUT/'schedule.json',schedule);write(OUT/'phase-schedule.json',phase_schedule)
started=time.monotonic();rows=[];gates=[];phases=[]
captures=OUT/'captures';captures.mkdir()
def signature(row):
 return sorted((t['input_sha256'],t['output_sha256'],t['query_count'],t['offline']['statistics'].get('quant-instantiations','0'),t['offline']['statistics'].get('rlimit-count','0')) for t in row['traces'])
def stop(reason):
 write(OUT/'stopped.json',{'reason':reason,'elapsed_s':time.monotonic()-started})
 raise SystemExit(reason)
for row in schedule:
 profile=spec['profiles'][row['profile']]
 settings={**spec,'options':[*spec['options'],*profile['options']]}
 result=trial(settings,row,captures);rows.append(result)
 with (OUT/'trials.jsonl').open('a') as f:f.write(json.dumps(result)+'\n')
 gate={'index':row['index'],'checks':{'valid':result['valid'],
  'expected_stream_count':len(result['traces'])==(1 if profile['solver']=='retained' else 2)}}
 prior=[r for r in rows[:-1] if r['case']==row['case'] and r['profile']==row['profile']]
 if result['valid'] and prior:gate['checks']['repeat_signature_equal']=signature(result)==signature(prior[0])
 reference=references.get((row['case'],row['profile']))
 if result['valid'] and reference:
  gate['historical_reference']={'folder':reference['folder'],'signature_equal':signature(result)==signature(reference)}
  if profile['saturation']=='current':gate['checks']['current_reference_equal']=gate['historical_reference']['signature_equal']
 gates.append(gate);write(OUT/'gates.json',gates)
 print('GATE',json.dumps(gate),flush=True)
 if not all(gate['checks'].values()):stop('Capture, outcome or reproducibility gate failed; no retry.')
for row in phase_schedule:
 case=next(c for c in spec['cases'] if c['name']==row['case']);profile=spec['profiles'][row['profile']]
 folder=OUT/f"phase-{row['index']:02d}-{row['case']}-{row['profile']}";folder.mkdir()
 command=['taskset','--cpu-list',spec['cpu_affinity'],spec['phase_command'],spec['z3'],*spec['options'],
  *profile['options'],'--parallelizeBranches=false','--proverSaturationTimeout','100',
  '--proverSaturationTimeoutWeights',profile['weights'],'--',case['path']]
 supervisor=[sys.executable,spec['supervisor'],'--timeout',str(spec['outer_timeout']),'--output',str(folder/'session.json'),'--',*command]
 print('PHASE START',row['index'],row['case'],row['profile'],flush=True)
 load=Path('/proc/loadavg').read_text().strip()
 proc=subprocess.run(supervisor,env={**os.environ,'FERRUM_BENCH_INTERNAL_CACHES':'on'},capture_output=True,text=True)
 (folder/'supervisor.log').write_text(proc.stdout+proc.stderr)
 session=json.loads((folder/'session.json').read_text())
 spans=[json.loads(line[len('@@PERF@@'):]) for line in session['raw_output'].splitlines() if line.startswith('@@PERF@@')]
 record={**row,'command':command,'session':str(folder/'session.json'),'wall_s':session['wall_seconds'],
  'phase_s':{p['phase']:int(p['elapsed_ns'])/1e9 for p in spans},'load_before':load,
  'load_after':Path('/proc/loadavg').read_text().strip(),'valid':proc.returncode==0 and check_outcome(session,case)}
 phases.append(record);write(OUT/'timings.json',phases)
 print('PHASE FINISH',row['case'],row['profile'],record['valid'],'wall',record['wall_s'],'verify',record['phase_s'].get('session_verify_inclusive'),flush=True)
 if not record['valid'] or 'session_verify_inclusive' not in record['phase_s']:stop('Invalid timing; no retry.')
postflight=[p for p,h in spec['artifact_sha256'].items() if sha(p)!=h]
summary={'gates':gates,'timings':phases,'elapsed_s':time.monotonic()-started,'postflight_errors':postflight}
write(OUT/'summary.json',summary)
print('DONE',summary['elapsed_s'],'postflight',postflight,flush=True)
raise SystemExit(bool(postflight))

"""Post-stop diagnosis, not a retry of the full verification workload."""
import json
import resource
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import sys
import time

ROOT=Path('/tmp/ferrum-method-saturation-dd263e8')
REPO=Path('/home/will/wk/exp/ferrum')
sys.path.insert(0,str(REPO/'tools/performance/smt'))
from run_saturation import sha,write
from analyze_trace import expressions

m=json.loads((ROOT/'slow-query-matches.json').read_text())
pair=min(m['pairs'],key=lambda p:p['combined']['index'])
spec=json.loads((ROOT/'experiment/spec.json').read_text())
output=ROOT/'prefix-diagnosis';output.mkdir()
records=[]
for index,name in enumerate(['current','combined']):
 source=Path(m['streams'][index]);q=pair[name]
 analysis=json.loads((source/'analysis.json').read_text())
 original_query=next(x for x in analysis['queries'] if x['index']==q['index'])
 raw=(source/'stdin.bin').read_bytes()[:q['end']]
 payload=raw+b'\n(get-info :reason-unknown)\n(get-info :all-statistics)\n'
 folder=output/name;folder.mkdir();(folder/'input.smt2').write_bytes(payload)
 command=['taskset','--cpu-list',spec['cpu_affinity'],spec['z3'],'-smt2','-in']
 before=resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_CHILDREN);start=time.monotonic()
 with (folder/'stdout.bin').open('wb') as out,(folder/'stderr.bin').open('wb') as err:
  try:
   process=subprocess.run(command,input=payload,stdout=out,stderr=err,timeout=30)
   status='completed';code=process.returncode
  except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
   status='timeout';code=None
 after=resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_CHILDREN)
 data=(folder/'stdout.bin').read_bytes();tokens=[data[a:b] for a,b in expressions(data)]
 original=(source/'stdout.bin').read_bytes();expected=[original[a:b] for a,b in expressions(original)][:original_query['response_index']+1]
 exact=len(tokens)==len(expected)+2 and tokens[:-2]==expected
 record={'variant':name,'source':str(source),'query':q,'command':command,'limit_s':30,
  'status':status,'exit_code':code,'wall_s':time.monotonic()-start,'cpu_s':after.ru_utime+after.ru_stime-before.ru_utime-before.ru_stime,
  'expected_original_responses':len(expected),'actual_responses':len(tokens),'original_response_prefix_equal':exact,
  'reason_unknown':tokens[-2].decode() if exact else None,'statistics_text':tokens[-1].decode() if exact else None,
  'stderr':(folder/'stderr.bin').read_text(),'artifact_sha256':{p.name:sha(p) for p in folder.iterdir()}}
 records.append(record);write(output/'results.json',records)
 print(json.dumps({k:record[k] for k in ['variant','status','wall_s','cpu_s','original_response_prefix_equal','reason_unknown','statistics_text']}),flush=True)
